podcast.title: Punk Subgenre
podcast.body: Oi emerged as one of the sub-genres into which punk rock mutated as it receded from the mainstream in the 1980s, preserving the punk attitude and DIY tenets. "It mutated into sub-genres like hardcore and oi and a narco punk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Punk Substyle
podcast.body: Oi! is identified as one of several sub-styles that emerged as the punk movement spread globally after its mid-1970s inception. "derivando en varios opestilos, como el hoy."
